profile_text.body:
D-ID describes itself as an AI generated video creation platform. Per its site, it builds realistic digital humans from images or video for both offline videos and real-time experiences, with voice cloning and multilingual output, and it says this replaces expensive video shooting with AI efficiency. It markets AI avatars and interactive AI agents for marketing, education, sales, and customer service, offers an API for building products with avatars, and lists integrations with Microsoft PowerPoint, Canva, and Google Slides. The company has also introduced NUI, the Natural User Interface, which it describes as aimed at changing how people interact with anything digital using AI.

Its named product is the Creative Reality Studio, which the company describes as a self-service platform combining its deep-learning face animation technology with LLM text generation and text-to-image capabilities, developed for businesses and individual content creators. D-ID says it has been recognized by G2 for leadership, ease of setup, and performance. Its site carries customer statements from Convo.ai, Pitango, and Grupo Formula and its subsidiaries TVOAI and Radio Formula.

D-ID is a video generation and editing company whose work is described as talking head AI and photo animation, with likeness rights and deepfake risk noted alongside it, and it is identified as an Israeli vendor. The material contains no litigation, SEC filing, or patent facts.
